name: aaron
overview: Aaron, the brother of Moses and son of Amram and Jochebed, was divinely appointed by God to serve as the first high priest of Israel, ministering in the priestly office alongside his sons (Exodus 6:20; 28:1). Scripture highlights that Aaron’s role was not self-assumed but a calling from God Himself, affirming his unique position as a prophet to Pharaoh and a saint of the LORD (Hebrews 5:4; Exodus 7:1; Psalms 106:16). His close relationship with Moses is emphasized, showing him as a supportive and eloquent spokesman chosen by God to aid in leading His people (Exodus 4:14).
